title: Detection of Static and Dynamic Stereopsis after Femtosecond Laser Small Incision Lenticule Extraction for High Myopia

license.statement: Creative Commons Attribution License, version not stated (article <license>)

indication: high myopia (eligibility: myopia over -6.00 D); bilateral SMILE in 43 patients

groups.description: Standard SMILE (VisuMax, 120 um cap) in both eyes of 43 patients (86 eyes); right (OD) and left (OS) eyes tabulated in separate rows

series.notes: right eyes; mean ± SD; per-visit n not reported
left eyes (fellow eyes of the same patients); mean ± SD; per-visit n not reported

exclusions.what: Static stereoacuity quartiles and dynamic stereopsis proportions
exclusions.reason: not refraction; medians and proportions are not admissible

notes: tab1 gives SE in OD and OS rows only, with no combined series; both rows are extracted as two series of one group because the study does not treat the eyes as separate groups (fellow eyes of the same 43 patients).
Method manifest: the Results call the preoperative SE the manifest refraction spherical equivalent.
Target unstated: no intended refraction is stated.
Visual acuity is tabulated but not extracted.
